topic.readerProblem: Agencies deciding whether and how to sell AEO / AI visibility as a service, audit many clients efficiently, price it and report results without overclaiming.
topic.connection: AEOeye's free ChatGPT audit and $29 per-brand full report give agencies a baseline and a pitch screen; the page says plainly that AEOeye has no agency plan, white-label output or multi-client monitoring and points to trackers for that.

assessment: The page replaces an older agency playbook that linked retired guides and implied agency-friendly tooling. It now lays out a three-product ladder (baseline audit, fix sprint, re-test), a first-hour access check, a standardized multi-client audit routine, scope-driven pricing with sourced market anchors, and a reporting scoreboard. It rests on AEOeye's crawler access study and recommendation benchmark (with caveats), Google and OpenAI documentation, SparkToro's published research, and vendors' own pricing pages. It does not claim hands-on use of Peec AI, guarantee outcomes, or present one agency's price list as an industry rate.

sources.supports: SEO best practices remain relevant for AI Overviews and AI Mode; no additional requirements to appear.
Search Generative AI performance reports show impressions, pages, countries, devices and dates; rolled out to all websites as of August 31, 2026; no click metric listed.
Sites that disallow OAI-SearchBot will not be shown in ChatGPT search answers.

2,961 runs; under 1-in-100 chance of identical brand lists; visibility % across many prompts reasonable, ranking position 'baloney'; 142 prompts with 0.081 semantic similarity; 994 responses with Bose, Sony, Sennheiser, Apple at 55-77%; Gumshoe.ai conflict disclosed.
Essential $245/mo (10,000 credits), Growth $495/mo (25,000 credits, 3-10 clients), Scale $795/mo (65,000 credits, 11-25+ clients); free pitch projects for prospects.
1 prompt x 1 model x 1 day = 1 credit.
Strategy & Consulting from $4,500/mo at 90-day program rate ($500/mo less than month-to-month); AI Search Blueprint 30-day sprint from $10,000 one-time; Power Hour $500.
GEO, also known as AEO, is the practice of improving visibility in responses generated by generative AI systems.
